_doc: V0 coverage matrix. One entry per brief in product-context/surfaces. tools/design/v0-gate.mjs fails when a brief is missing, a persona is outside the four, a badge appears outside Workspace Admin review, or a route or story id names an excluded feature. Story ids are the intended ids of future V0 stories; a V0 story exists only when its DSN record creates the production-shaped component, so `dsn` stays null until then.

surfaces.title: Inventor home
surfaces.userGoal: Start an idea or understand what happened to existing ideas.
surfaces.businessGoal: Increase submission starts and inventor participation.

states.loading: skeleton that resembles the final composition
states.empty: no ideas yet: Submit an idea leads, momentum shows the workspace
states.success: ideas with statuses and next steps, one active draft to continue
states.error: ideas unavailable, Submit an idea still works
states.permission: not applicable: every inventor reaches home

surfaces.backendNotes: Collective momentum (submissions this quarter, ideas that reached filing) needs workspace counts by period; GET /v1/dashboard-style aggregates exist for pipeline counts, a period breakdown is not exposed today.

surfaces.title: Start an idea
surfaces.userGoal: Move from 'I may have an invention' to a useful starting disclosure with almost no blank-page friction.

routes.note: production starts an idea from the ideas page; the V0 entry point is the Submit an idea action
the transition target once material is organised

states.loading: parsing pasted or uploaded material with visible progress
states.empty: plain invitation to describe or bring the idea; paste and upload lead
states.success: material organised into a structured disclosure with continuity from source to prefilled answers
states.error: extraction failure or unsupported file with the material preserved
states.permission: Workspace Admin on behalf of an inventor is conceptual until the backend grants creation and submission to LEGAL_COUNSEL

surfaces.backendNotes: Prefill from source material uses POST /v1/drafts/:id/autofill and file upload (exists). Workspace Admin submitting on behalf of a selected inventor needs idea:create and idea:submit for LEGAL_COUNSEL plus a submitter identity on the idea (BF-1); the mock models it behind mock/proposed-fields.json.

surfaces.title: Invention disclosure workspace
surfaces.userGoal: Complete a credible invention disclosure without needing patent expertise.
surfaces.businessGoal: Increase draft completion and completed-to-submitted conversion.

states.loading: draft loading; sections keep their shape
states.empty: new disclosure with no prefilled answer
states.success: complete disclosure ready to submit; Submit for review leads, Evaluate idea visibly optional
states.error: save failed with entered work preserved; evaluation failed
states.permission: a Workspace Admin editing an inventor's submitted content is refused; on-behalf drafting is conceptual

surfaces.backendNotes: Drafts, autosave, evaluate, re-evaluate, autofill and suggest exist. Per-answer provenance (AI-drafted, edited, human) and a version history that freezes the reviewed revision are not stored today; the mock keeps revision numbers on transitions only.

surfaces.title: Evaluation result
surfaces.userGoal: Understand the advisory novelty assessment and strengthen the disclosure.
surfaces.businessGoal: Help inventors submit stronger disclosures without reducing submission volume.

routes.note: evaluation is opened from the disclosure workspace
the summary and detailed evidence on the idea

states.empty: not run: Evaluate idea offered, never required
states.success: assessment, what appears different, how to strengthen; detailed prior art collapsed
states.error: failed or timed out with a retry that keeps the disclosure
states.permission: not applicable inside the inventor's own idea

surfaces.backendNotes: POST evaluate, POST re-evaluate and GET evaluation exist; the envelope carries score, noveltyScore, closestMatches, recommendations, priorArt. Whether closestMatches carries per-reference differences for 'What appears different' is verified in the evaluation record (BF-2 if not).

surfaces.title: Ideas list
surfaces.userGoal: Inventor: find own drafts and submissions and their next step. Workspace Admin: clear pending reviews. Case Owner: find approved ideas from assigned clients. Photon Admin: oversee ideas sent to Photon across clients.
surfaces.businessGoal: Faster review and a clear next step for every idea.

states.loading: table skeleton with the persona's columns
states.empty: no ideas, drafts only, or a filter that matches nothing
states.success: mixed statuses sorted by the persona's job; pending review oldest first with days waiting
states.permission: inventors see own and credited ideas only; case owners assigned clients only

surfaces.backendNotes: GET /v1/ideas with state filters and paging exists.
excludes: preview step before opening a record
badges for any persona but Workspace Admin

surfaces.title: Idea detail and status
surfaces.userGoal: Understand the invention disclosure, its evidence, history, ownership and current next step.
surfaces.businessGoal: Confidence after submission and review; a usable filing brief for Photon.

states.loading: reference and title first, sections follow
states.success: every state of the V0 lifecycle with the next step named
states.permission: an idea outside the caller's scope is refused; role-specific actions hidden

surfaces.backendNotes: Separate Inventor and Submitted by attribution needs a submitter identity on the idea (BF-1, modelled as submitted_by_id in mock/proposed-fields.json). Granted and Closed render from the linked patent (POST /v1/patents/:id/link-idea exists).

surfaces.title: Review decision
surfaces.userGoal: Understand an invention quickly enough to make a defensible client decision.
surfaces.businessGoal: Faster review and more suitable ideas sent to Photon Legal.

routes.note: one decision workspace on the idea; no preview screen

states.loading: decision in progress keeps the button label and shows activity
states.empty: no evaluation: decide from the disclosure
states.success: Approve & send confirmed; status Sent to Photon Legal
states.error: decision failed with retry, reason preserved
states.permission: a second Workspace Admin sees the recorded outcome and actor

surfaces.backendNotes: POST /v1/drafts/:id/review with APPROVED, CHANGES_REQUESTED or REJECTED exists; APPROVED at the legal stage moves the idea to SENT_TO_PHOTON. Transitions carry the actor for the concurrent-decision state.

surfaces.title: Workspace Admin dashboard
surfaces.userGoal: Clear the review queue and understand whether the invention program is moving.
surfaces.businessGoal: Reduce submission-to-decision time and increase ideas sent to Photon.

states.loading: stat strip skeleton at final size, then the queue; the map loads last
states.empty: no pending reviews; no Actions due; no submissions this quarter; empty portfolio; one inventor
states.success: five scoped stat boxes (awaiting review with oldest wait, Actions due in 30 days, submitted this quarter with delta, total patents, granted), Patents worldwide, Top inventors by period, Review Inventor Ideas oldest first, Idea pipeline
states.error: overview numbers unavailable with retry; the queue still loads independently
states.permission: Workspace Admin only; dates appear only in the Actions box

surfaces.backendNotes: BF-5: GET /v1/dashboard needs workspace-scoped aggregates (awaiting review and oldest wait, Actions due in 30 days and next date, submissions per calendar quarter with the prior-quarter delta, patents filed this quarter, patents by jurisdiction, top inventors per period), each exposing the filter its number links to. Pipeline counts and patent totals exist today.
founderOverrides: patent world map kept as Patents worldwide (R-07, revisit after V0 usage evidence)
Top inventors ranking kept (DESIGN-PHILOSOPHY section 9, revisit after V0 usage evidence)
queue and navigation item labelled Review Inventor Ideas

surfaces.title: Patent portfolio
surfaces.userGoal: Understand the company's patent assets and find a specific record quickly.
surfaces.businessGoal: Portfolio visibility that supports the service relationship and shows inventors that invention is valued.

states.empty: empty imported portfolio; filter matches nothing
states.success: typical and thousands of records, jurisdiction distribution as counts and filters
states.permission: Inventor and Workspace Admin read-only, no import; upcoming-date indicator hidden from Inventor

surfaces.backendNotes: GET /v1/patents with paging, stats, tags, export and import exist.

surfaces.title: Patent detail
surfaces.userGoal: Understand one patent's identity, legal and lifecycle state, family, documents and relationship to the originating idea.
surfaces.businessGoal: Lifecycle visibility without an internal IP operations team.

states.empty: incomplete imported record; no originating idea; no documents
states.success: pending, filed, granted, inactive, closed with the lifecycle timeline
states.permission: Inventor read-only with no dates; Workspace Admin read-only with contextual dates and Actions; Photon roles edit

surfaces.backendNotes: GET and PATCH /v1/patents/:id exist with family and timeline fields; documents attached to a patent are not modelled beyond import files today.

surfaces.title: Actions
surfaces.userGoal: Workspace Admin: decide and submit the client's instruction for an upcoming patent event. Case Owner and Photon Admin: receive, process and update client requests.
surfaces.businessGoal: Reduce coordination delay between the client's instruction and Photon's operational response.

routes.note: production's client Actions page lives on this path; V0 offers it as Actions and adds no Due Dates destination

states.empty: no upcoming event needing an instruction
states.success: saved draft, submitted, updated; Photon side acknowledged, in progress, completed, declined
states.error: submission error with the instruction preserved; missing template or configuration
states.permission: Inventor is refused; every status names who owns the next step

surfaces.backendNotes: Templates, queue, submit-all, decide, request-status and resolve exist.

surfaces.title: Photon due dates
surfaces.userGoal: Find upcoming or overdue client patent events and maintain accurate visibility.
surfaces.businessGoal: Nothing is missed across assigned or all clients.

states.success: upcoming, due soon, overdue, completed, large same-day groups; calendar secondary
states.error: list unavailable; import problem flagged on a row
states.permission: Workspace Admin sees dates only in Actions and patent detail; Inventor never

surfaces.backendNotes: GET /v1/due-dates with filters, PATCH status and remind exist. Data comes from manual update and spreadsheet import only.

surfaces.title: Workspace, people and profile
surfaces.userGoal: Configure the organization and get inventors participating; keep personal profile and preferences distinct.
surfaces.businessGoal: More eligible inventors enter the workspace and begin submissions.

states.success: active team, invitations pending, share link and QR, bulk email paste, CSV import result
states.error: save error; CSV errors; domain conflict
states.permission: Inventor sees Profile only; Case Owner adds Workspace Admins and invites inventors on assigned clients

surfaces.backendNotes: Invites, share link, users, client configuration and notification preferences exist; bulk email paste and inventor CSV import compose the existing invite API; email preference categories beyond the three stored flags are conceptual (BF-3).

surfaces.title: Case Owner my work
surfaces.userGoal: Know which assigned client needs attention and move approved work forward.
surfaces.businessGoal: Reduce coordination delay between client approval and Photon service delivery.

states.success: approved ideas newly sent to Photon, urgent Actions and dates, onboarding tasks, client health
states.error: data error with scope still visible
states.permission: assigned clients only; client view visibly distinct and easy to exit

surfaces.backendNotes: Composed from ideas, actions, due dates and clients lists that exist; no dedicated aggregate.

surfaces.title: Clients and onboarding
surfaces.userGoal: Find an assigned or any client, understand its setup, and complete onboarding.
surfaces.businessGoal: Clients become ready faster: admin invited, inventors invited, portfolio imported.

routes.note: client detail and onboarding open from the list in production

states.empty: no clients assigned; potential client without a workspace
states.success: ready client workspace with admins, participation, portfolio summary, import history, assignments
states.error: import duplicates or errors; save failed
states.permission: Case Owner assigned clients only; enter client view when authorized

surfaces.backendNotes: Clients, case-owner assignments, users, invites and import exist. The plan field is never surfaced.

surfaces.title: Photon Admin dashboard
surfaces.userGoal: Ensure clients, ownership, incoming work and operational exceptions are under control across Photon Legal.
surfaces.businessGoal: Convert more approved ideas into well-managed patent work without losing client ownership or data quality.

states.success: unassigned clients, newly approved ideas, urgent Actions and dates, configuration exceptions, compact totals
states.error: partial data with the missing source named

surfaces.backendNotes: Composed from lists that exist; firm totals and trends have no dedicated aggregate.

surfaces.title: Authentication and access
surfaces.userGoal: Enter the correct workspace securely with minimal uncertainty.
surfaces.businessGoal: More invited and domain-eligible inventors activate successfully.

states.empty: default login with recommended methods and the email fallback
states.error: invalid credentials, unknown domain, expired invitation, SSO unavailable or failed, with entered values preserved
states.permission: access denied and session expired explain the next step

surfaces.backendNotes: Password, Google, Microsoft and SAML providers, signup with domain check, invites, forgot and reset exist. Authentication errors never reveal whether an account exists.
excludes: empty half-page where a brand panel was
